description: Make a subclip of a clip project item (Clip > Make Subclip): a new project item limited to a range of the source, optionally restricted so it cannot be trimmed past it (Premiere Pro 26.3 or later). Returns the new item

item.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

restrictTrims.description: Restrict Trims to Subclip Boundaries. Default false

name: create_subclip
title: Create Subclip
